test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

OBSTRUCTION
solution: The correct answer is '**Hindrance**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Obstruction**' is '**Hindrance**'. • **Obstruction**: the act of stopping something from happening or moving. (बाधा, रुकावट, अड़चन, अवरोध) • *Example: This car is causing an **obstruction**.* • **Hindrance**: a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something, an obstacle or obstruction. (किसी काम में कठिनाई पैदा करने वाला व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु, बाधक तत्‍व; रुकावट, बाधा, विघ्‍न) • *Example: The floods have been a major **hindrance** to relief efforts.* **Correct Answer:__** *Hindrance.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Destruction**: the action of destroying something. (विनाश-क्रिया, विध्वंस) • **Guesswork**: an act of guessing. (अंदाज़ा या अनुमान लगाना; अटकलबाज़ी) • **Construction**: the act or method of building or making something. (निर्माण कार्य या पद्घति) 3b:Tce3, The correct answer is '**to post**'.
